# Village of Derby Line municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 7; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Title 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 217 section 202 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): provides for the election of three Trustees on staggered 3-year terms.

Village of Derby Line '2025 Officers' Annual Report for the year ending February 28, 2026 (derbyvt.org): lists Sarah Webster (Chair, term expiring 2027), Dustin Horne (Vice-Chairman, term expiring 2026), and Brian Lemery (term expiring 2028).

Village of Derby Line trustee minutes, posted on the village's agenda page (derbyvt.org): the April 21, 2026 reorganization minutes seat Horne as Chair and Lemery as Vice Chair (Horne's seat stood at the April 7, 2026 annual meeting); the May 28, 2026 minutes accept Trustee Sarah Webster's resignation; the June 2, 2026 minutes appoint Tristan Ovitt as the third trustee until the April 2027 annual meeting; the August 4, 2026 minutes show Horne, Lemery, and Ovitt sitting. Webster is not recorded as a current holder.
Title 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 217 section 202 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): provides for the election of a Village Clerk.

Village of Derby Line '2025 Officers' Annual Report for the year ending February 28, 2026 (derbyvt.org): lists Peggy Kelley as Clerk & Treasurer and as Delinquent Water, Sewer & Tax Collector, each on a 3-year term expiring 2028.
Village of Derby Line Warning for the annual meeting of April 7, 2026, attested February 24, 2026 by Peggy Kelley, Clerk (derbyvt.org): is attested by Peggy Kelley as village Clerk in February 2026.

Title 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 217 section 202 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): provides for the election of a Moderator for a 1-year term. Structure only: Frank Davis held the office to April 2026 per the village's 2025 Officers report, and no official source publishes the winner of the April 7, 2026 election; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Village of Derby Line '2025 Officers' Annual Report for the year ending February 28, 2026 (derbyvt.org): lists three village Auditors on staggered 3-year terms: Charles Gross (expiring 2026), Roberta Pheiffer (2027), and Madeleine Roy (2028).

Village of Derby Line Warning for the annual meeting of April 7, 2026, attested February 24, 2026 by Peggy Kelley, Clerk (derbyvt.org): warns the election of one Auditor for a 3-year term at the April 7, 2026 annual meeting; no official source publishes the winner, so Gross's seat is left unfilled.
Village of Derby Line '2025 Officers' Annual Report for the year ending February 28, 2026 (derbyvt.org): lists Karen Jenne as Water Commissioner on a 1-year term expiring 2026.
